import re

spreadsheet_path = "/mnt/data/spreadsheet/353-29/1_353-29_input.xlsx"
output_path = "/mnt/data/outputs/353-29_0_9019b322/1_353-29_output.xlsx"

def letters_from_index(n):
    # 1 -> a, 2 -> b, ..., 26 -> z, 27 -> aa, 28 -> ab, etc.
    result = ""
    while n > 0:
        n -= 1
        result = chr(ord("a") + (n % 26)) + result
        n //= 26
    return result

def split_urn(value):
    # Returns the numeric base and existing letter suffix, if present.
    if value is None or value == "":
        return None, ""
    if isinstance(value, float) and value.is_integer():
        text = str(int(value))
    else:
        text = str(value)
    match = re.match(r"^(\d+)([A-Za-z]*)$", text)
    if match:
        return match.group(1), match.group(2).lower()
    return text, ""

def suffix_to_index(suffix):
    # a -> 1, z -> 26, aa -> 27, etc.; no suffix -> 0.
    if not suffix:
        return 0
    n = 0
    for ch in suffix.lower():
        if "a" <= ch <= "z":
            n = n * 26 + (ord(ch) - ord("a") + 1)
    return n

wb = load_workbook(spreadsheet_path)
ws = wb["Sheet1"]

# The allowed answer range is Sheet1!A1:B90, so only work within those rows.
max_allowed_row = 90

# Detect the actual populated extent within the allowed range.
last_row = 1
for r in range(1, min(ws.max_row, max_allowed_row) + 1):
    if ws.cell(r, 1).value is not None or ws.cell(r, 2).value is not None:
        last_row = r

current_base = None
current_suffix_index = 0

# Row 1 is the header. Fill only blank URN cells in column A for populated data rows.
for r in range(2, last_row + 1):
    cell = ws.cell(r, 1)
    value = cell.value

    if value is None or value == "":
        if current_base is not None:
            current_suffix_index += 1
            cell.value = f"{current_base}{letters_from_index(current_suffix_index)}"
    else:
        current_base, suffix = split_urn(value)
        current_suffix_index = suffix_to_index(suffix)
